title: Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Extensions: Eligibility and Effect
content:
1. An extension of a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract can be granted only while the contract status is active.
2. The contract must show installments satisfied of at least the tier's minimum for an extension, days past due of no more than the tier's maximum, and installments already deferred over its life plus the installments requested no greater than the tier's lifetime maximum.
3. No extension is granted when the remaining installments — the term in months plus the installments deferred over the life of the contract, less the installments satisfied — are the blackout figure or fewer.
4. No extension is granted while any other Kestrel contract of the customer is assigned for repossession, repossessed, in deficiency or charged off, or any Kestrel lease of the customer is repossessed or charged off.
5. An extension may take effect no earlier than the minimum interval in calendar months after the previous extension took effect. The interval is counted in calendar months from the last extension date to the same day number of the later month, falling back to that month's last day when the day does not exist; a contract never extended has no interval to wait. Taking effect on the day the interval ends is permitted.
6. One request may defer no more than the tier's installments per request, always starting with the installment due on the next due date.
7. Before the extension is granted, a good-faith payment of at least the tier's good-faith percent of the monthly payment, rounded to the cent, must have posted since the most recent installment due date; a tier whose percentage is 0 requires none.
8. The agent sends the extension agreement for signature, and it expires if not completed within the agreement return days, in calendar days. The extension takes effect only after the customer has completed the signed extension agreement for this contract.
9. The extension fee is the tier's extension fee where the contract records that its state permits an extension fee, and 0.00 where it does not; the fee is booked to fees due.
10. On the effective date the next due date and the maturity date each move later by one month per deferred installment, the installments deferred over the life increase by the number deferred and the last extension date is set; simple interest keeps accruing on principal throughout, so the final installment absorbs the extra interest. Late charges already assessed remain due, and no late charge is assessed on a deferred installment.

### Remaining-installment check (hypothetical, blackout of 6)

A 48-month contract with 2 installments deferred over its life and 43 installments satisfied has 48 plus 2 less 43, that is 7, remaining: an extension is not blocked by the blackout. With 44 satisfied, 6 remain and no extension is granted.
